concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Actual pixels inspected after tool receipt. All rows are concept art, not specimen evidence. Vermicularia shows a loose curved tube with a thick aperture but bead-like apex; replace apex with a continuous regular initial helix. Back aperture is visually capped in the concept: author one real open adult aperture with an inner lumen ending in the narrowing juvenile shell, not two adult openings. Weichselia shows short brown cortex and raised bosses; cut face simplified, concentric color ring means cortex/core only, not growth rings or multiple stems. Ventifact has three dominant abrasion planes and restrained broken base. Pentichnus has a deep tapering hollow and front cut; retain five planar cavity walls and illustrative section. Third column is oblique overhead for most rows, not canonical top. Hidden surfaces are authored as continuous full volumes; no exact specimen dimensions inferred.
concept.hidden_surface_decisions: Real full volume: rear and underside authored continuously; simplified internal shell, cortex/core and five-sided sectional cavity are explicit design interpretations, not measured reconstructions.
